label: Canonical registration is one _routes.yaml standalone block (:228-240) plus the update.md router and a doctor-<command> asset pair; rebuilding as a family repeats this shape per command

command-catalog-mirror-check.cjs enforces rename copies: structural tier (coverage, identity, counts, resolvable resources) exits 1 on a stale README.txt row/count or an orphan name; prose tier warns. Doctor has no per-family README.txt and no command-metadata.json entry today
